v0_5_116.provenance: upstream master commits 1339107e (package.json 0.5.116) and eaeb54a6 (CHANGELOG.md # v0.5.116); untagged on git/GitHub releases

audit_summary.intermediate_releases_found: None (upstream jumped directly from 0.5.112 to 0.5.116; no 0.5.113, 0.5.114, 0.5.115 tags or version bumps exist)

clusters.name: Transport & Network Resilience
clusters.rationale: Adapt undici 8 / happy eyeballs / keepalive timeouts and fresh socket retries to Bun runtime; enforce AWS region restrictions in kiro executor.

clusters.name: OpenCode Go Endpoint & Reasoning Migration
clusters.rationale: Migrates endpoints from retired /zen/go/v1 to /inference/go/* and enables adaptive thinking on Claude transport.

clusters.name: CommandCode CLI v1.88.5 Alignment & Auto-Import
clusters.rationale: Aligns wire protocol with CLI 1.88.5 and imports auth.json; MUST add ALWAYS_PROTECTED + LOCAL_ONLY_PATHS in dashboardGuard.js.

clusters.name: CodeBuddy Intl System Prompt & WAF Sanitization
clusters.rationale: Forwards user system prompts and sanitizes CLI agent identity markers.

clusters.name: Codex Image & Media Updates
clusters.rationale: Routes Codex image generation to native Images API safely, adds GPT Image 2.6 models, and sends concrete MIME for Gemini remote images.

clusters.name: Translator & Thinking Logic Refinements
clusters.rationale: Preserves thinking on tool-result turns, retains explicit DeepSeek thinking budgets, preserves Claude cache markers for DashScope, keeps all Gemini tool parts, and cleans tool_reference blocks.

clusters.name: Provider Quota & Catalog Updates
clusters.rationale: Antigravity Gemini 4 Argon quota separation, SenseNova model list update, Jina/Tavily web fetch output formats.

clusters.name: TTS Voices In-Process Service Refactoring
clusters.rationale: Eliminates HTTP self-fetch loop by extracting shared in-process ttsVoices service.

clusters.name: CLI Launcher Optimization & Dashboard Tools
clusters.rationale: PID-file launcher optimization, PoW worker packaging, tray startup verification, and CLI tools active model expansion.

clusters.name: OpenCode Free Tier Terminal Tool Aliasing
clusters.rationale: Already ported and verified in KhatamRouter PR #124 (commit 6d911210, Spec 016).

clusters.name: Architecturally Inapplicable Runtime Files
clusters.rationale: Modifies lazyRuntime.js and sqliteRuntime.js, which are removed in KhatamRouter per Bun-only and no-dynamic-npm invariants.

clusters.name: Release Boundaries & Version Commits
clusters.rationale: Changelog and version bump marking official v0.5.116 release.

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: Fix OpenCode
commits.behavior: Workaround dynamic ESM createRequire import in runtime downloader for OpenCode Free dependencies.
commits.securityConcerns: Dynamic runtime package downloads via npm introduce unauthenticated remote code execution and supply-chain risk.
commits.rationale: KhatamRouter strictly prohibits dynamic runtime package downloads via npm. Resolved natively at build time via wreq-js optionalDependency under Bun in PR #78 (Spec 012).

commits.author: Cristiano
commits.subject: feat(codex): add GPT-6.1 Terra
commits.behavior: Adds gpt-6.1-terra model with responsesLite support, 500k context window, pricing, and thinking configuration.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: Jerxx
commits.subject: fix(codebuddy): send plugin request/conversation id headers
commits.behavior: Sends official CodeBuddy conversation and request headers (X-Request-ID, X-Conversation-ID) to avoid channel blocks.
commits.securityConcerns: Header injection prevented by sanitizing request/conversation UUIDs.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: blackthunder0812
commits.subject: fix(github): apply Claude 5.5 thinking rules to Copilot's dotted model ids
commits.behavior: Applies Claude 5.5 thinking rules to GitHub Copilot dotted model names (e.g. claude-3.5-sonnet).
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: Bertho Joris
commits.subject: feat(commandcode): align request headers with official CLI 1.88.0
commits.behavior: Replaces hardcoded version 0.25.7 with official CLI 1.88.0 identity headers and synchronizes conversation session IDs.
commits.securityConcerns: Path slugification guarded against directory traversal and path leakage.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: thienpv
commits.subject: fix(providers): treat LLM|id|secret as opaque token in bulk-add, not name|key
commits.behavior: Treats Muse keys formatted as LLM|id|secret as opaque tokens during bulk key add instead of splitting on first pipe.
commits.securityConcerns: Prevents credential truncation during bulk import.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: minhnhat166
commits.subject: fix(nvidia): normalize reasoning aliases for NIM
commits.behavior: Renames reasoning to reasoning_content for NVIDIA NIM to avoid duplicate-field 400 Bad Request errors.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: Thanh Tuan
commits.subject: feat: add Nace Drex provider to the System One lane
commits.behavior: Adds Nace Drex provider with drex-max and drex-v2.0 models to System One lane.
commits.securityConcerns: Regenerated registry index automatically to prevent manual tampering.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: Bertho Joris
commits.subject: fix(translator): enforce Gemini protobuf type predicates on schema items and properties
commits.behavior: Strips items from non-array schemas and properties/required from non-object schemas in Gemini translator to prevent 400 errors.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: blackthunder0812
commits.subject: fix(chat): reject SSE errors in non-streaming responses
commits.behavior: Extracts clamped HTTP status codes (400-599 or 502) from SSE error frames in non-streaming responses instead of returning phantom 200 OK.
commits.securityConcerns: Prevents masking upstream security or auth errors as successful 200 OK responses.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: fix(docker): bundle lazy runtime deps so OpenCode Free resolves
commits.behavior: Ran npm install wreq-js playwright-core during Docker build to compensate for lazy runtime dynamic imports.
commits.securityConcerns: Reintroduces npm and non-deterministic package installation into Docker builds.
commits.rationale: Superseded in KhatamRouter PR #78 and Spec 013. KhatamRouter bundles wreq-js natively via Bun with byte-identical Dockerfiles.

commits.author: fanyzp
commits.subject: fix(deepseek): use noble-hashes port for DeepSeek PoW hash
commits.behavior: Inlines pure-JS Keccak/SHA3-256 implementation for DeepSeek PoW challenge solver.
commits.securityConcerns: Upstream lacked input validation; KhatamRouter added strict input validation (difficulty ceiling 250,000, hex regex check) to prevent DoS.
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: feat(minimax-code): lease auth mode via desktop app named-pipe broker
commits.behavior: Implements desktop IPC named-pipe lease broker for MiniMax Code credentials.
commits.securityConcerns: Added 64KB frame ceiling, path traversal protection, loopback-only check, Redis cross-worker caching, and ephemeral in-memory storage (never stored in SQLite).
commits.rationale: Ported in Spec 013 (PR #119 commit 9b56a40a).

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: # v0.5.112 (2026-10-28)
commits.behavior: Official release commit and changelog for v0.5.112.
commits.rationale: Version bumped and changelog recorded in KhatamRouter PR #119 and #120.

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: fix(transport): survive DPI-shaped networks on the claude provider
commits.behavior: Configures happy eyeballs (autoSelectFamily: true, 250ms fallback) and X25519 TLS curve on undici Agent to survive DPI RST on api.anthropic.com; routes Claude token refresh in testUtils through proxyAwareFetch; drops ipv4first flag.
commits.securityConcerns: DPI bypass must not compromise TLS certificate validation. Strict SSL and MITM certificate handling preserved.
commits.rationale: Adapt to Bun runtime environment while preserving proxyAwareFetch in testUtils and curved TLS ClientHello configuration.

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: fix(runtime): keep named exports when loading CJS deps from the runtime dir
commits.behavior: Fixes named exports extraction when dynamically loading CJS modules from lazyRuntime directory.
commits.securityConcerns: lazyRuntime.js performs arbitrary child-process npm installs at runtime, introducing severe RCE and supply-chain vulnerabilities.
commits.rationale: KhatamRouter constitutionally prohibits lazyRuntime.js and dynamic npm installs. OpenCode dependencies (wreq-js) are built-in native Bun optionalDependencies (PR #78, #119).

commits.author: chisewaguri
commits.subject: fix(opencode-go): use Claude reasoning on the Messages transport
commits.behavior: Sets thinkingFormat: 'claude-adaptive' on OpenCode Go Messages transport and passes adaptive thinking blocks to DeepSeek models.
commits.rationale: Clean port to enable adaptive thinking for OpenCode Go DeepSeek models.

commits.author: FuatCemOzyazici
commits.subject: fix(codex-image): use native OAuth image generation safely
commits.behavior: Routes standard GPT Image requests to native Codex Images endpoint instead of Responses SSE path which failed with complexity=medium error.
commits.securityConcerns: Credentials and account IDs passed securely via Authorization and chatgpt-account-id headers.
commits.rationale: Clean port for reliable Codex OAuth image generation.

commits.author: Sutarto Jordan Chrisfivo
commits.subject: fix(thinking): preserve intent on OpenAI tool-result turns
commits.behavior: Retains body.thinking when last message is role: 'tool' (OpenAI tool-result turns), preventing budget deletion during multi-turn tool calling.
commits.rationale: Clean port fixing thinking budget preservation during agent tool loops.

commits.author: Erfan Bagheri
commits.subject: fix(opencode): alias declared tool names containing "terminal" on the free tier
commits.behavior: Aliases tool names matching /terminal/i to run_command to bypass OpenCode free tier 429 gate.
commits.rationale: Already ported and verified in KhatamRouter PR #124 (commit 6d911210, Spec 016).

commits.author: mj10612
commits.subject: fix(tts): list public voices without dashboard self-fetch auth
commits.behavior: Extracts voice fetching into shared in-process src/lib/ttsVoices.js, allowing /v1/audio/voices to respond to API-key clients without triggering dashboard 401.
commits.securityConcerns: Eliminates insecure HTTP self-fetch loop, reducing latency and SSRF surface.
commits.rationale: Clean architectural fix replacing internal HTTP self-fetch with in-process module call.

commits.author: mj10612
commits.subject: fix(translator): retain Claude cache markers for DashScope targets
commits.behavior: Preserves Claude cache_control markers and system block boundaries when translating to DashScope OpenAI targets.
commits.rationale: Clean port enabling prompt caching on DashScope models.

commits.author: zeroonek
commits.subject: perf(cli): cut launcher startup ~2.5x by skipping machine-wide process scans
commits.behavior: Saves PID in <dataDir>/launcher.pid and stops recorded processes directly instead of running machine-wide process scans (PowerShell/WMI/ps).
commits.securityConcerns: PID reuse validation checks executable identity (/proc/<pid>/exe, tasklist, ps).
commits.rationale: Clean optimization for CLI package.

commits.author: Hai Trinh
commits.subject: fix(gemini): send concrete MIME for remote images
commits.behavior: Infers concrete MIME from image extension instead of emitting generic image/* which Google Antigravity rejects with 400.
commits.securityConcerns: MIME type chosen from fixed whitelist to prevent header injection.
commits.rationale: Clean bug fix for Gemini remote image handling.

commits.author: mj10612
commits.subject: fix(translator): preserve all Gemini tool results and follow-up parts
commits.behavior: Collects all function responses in parts loop instead of early return on first functionResponse, preserving parallel tool execution results.
commits.rationale: Clean fix for parallel tool calls in Gemini to OpenAI translation.

commits.author: Hai Trinh
commits.subject: fix(codex-image): handle upstream image tool failures
commits.behavior: Stops sending reasoning.effort=medium on Codex image tool requests and surfaces real upstream errors.
commits.rationale: Clean fix companion to 783c9325.

commits.author: fanyzp
commits.subject: fix(cli): ship deepseek-pow-hash.js next to PoW worker
commits.behavior: Ensures deepseek-pow-hash.js is packaged alongside deepseek-pow-worker.mjs in CLI build bundle.
commits.rationale: Adapt to KhatamRouter CLI packaging scripts.

commits.author: mr-robot77
commits.subject: feat(antigravity): track and display separate Gemini 4 Argon quota
commits.behavior: Separates Gemini 4 Argon quota tracking and display from shared Gemini weekly pool in Antigravity.
commits.rationale: Clean feature addition for Antigravity Google AI Pro plans.

commits.author: mj10612
commits.subject: fix(fetch): honor requested Jina and Tavily output formats
commits.behavior: Forwards requested formats to Jina Reader (x-respond-with header) and Tavily (format body field) with validation against registry.
commits.securityConcerns: Validation prevents format parameter reflection from injecting arbitrary content.
commits.rationale: Clean fix for web fetch tool format compliance.

commits.author: thienpv
commits.subject: fix(kiro): stop splicing unserved regions into service hostnames
commits.behavior: Restricts Amazon service hostname region splicing to served regions (q: us-east-1, eu-central-1; codewhisperer: us-east-1), preventing NXDOMAIN hangs and origin spoofing.
commits.securityConcerns: Prevents SSRF and authorization bearer token leakage to attacker-controlled domains via arbitrary region strings.
commits.rationale: Security-critical fix for Kiro endpoint routing.

commits.author: mj10612
commits.subject: fix(thinking): preserve explicit DeepSeek thinking budgets on compat nodes
commits.behavior: Preserves explicit client-supplied thinking.budget_tokens on openai-compatible-* nodes instead of replacing with bare boolean.
commits.rationale: Clean fix for vLLM/SGLang compatibility.

commits.author: Sofia
commits.subject: feat(codex-image): add GPT Image 2.6 models
commits.behavior: Registers gpt-image-2.6-flare and gpt-image-2.6-sunburst models with capabilities, pricing, and image generation handlers.
commits.rationale: Clean model addition.

commits.author: blackthunder0812
commits.subject: fix(tray): report a tray that never started instead of claiming success
commits.behavior: Verifies tray process startup and returns descriptive error instead of falsely reporting tray success.
commits.rationale: Clean fix for CLI tray runtime status.

commits.author: 钛白
commits.subject: feat(sensenova): add sensenova-6.8-flash and glm-5.3 to model list
commits.behavior: Adds sensenova-6.8-flash and glm-5.3 to SenseNova provider registry model list.
commits.rationale: Clean model list update.

commits.author: minhnhat166
commits.subject: fix(proxyFetch): stop reusing dead keep-alive sockets upstream edges drop silently
commits.behavior: Caps keep-alive socket TTL (default 4s), classifies stale sockets, retries once on fresh socket when keep-alive connection dropped silently; drops stream_options on non-streaming requests in default executor.
commits.securityConcerns: Fresh socket retry specifically excludes DNS/TLS errors and bare 'fetch failed' to prevent duplicate billing.
commits.rationale: Adapt keep-alive capping and stale-socket recovery to KhatamRouter's custom proxyFetch implementation, and drop stream_options in default.js.

commits.author: AhooraZen
commits.subject: fix(codebuddy-intl): preserve client system prompts and sanitize CLI agent identity
commits.behavior: Forwards user system prompts and sanitizes CLI agent identity markers to prevent Tencent WAF blocks on CodeBuddy Intl.
commits.securityConcerns: Preserves user prompt content while sanitizing trigger tokens.
commits.rationale: Clean fix for CodeBuddy Intl gateway.

commits.author: alwaghani
commits.subject: feat(commandcode): align data bridge with CLI v1.88.5 and add CLI auto-import
commits.behavior: Aligns Command Code provider with official CLI v1.88.5 (tool tracking, error formatting, max_tokens 64k) and adds GET /api/oauth/commandcode/auto-import to import ~/.commandcode/auth.json.
commits.securityConcerns: CRITICAL: Upstream omitted dashboardGuard authentication and localhost-only checks on /api/oauth/commandcode/auto-import! KhatamRouter MUST add it to ALWAYS_PROTECTED and LOCAL_ONLY_PATHS in src/dashboardGuard.js to prevent remote unauthenticated reading of local credentials.
commits.rationale: Port protocol alignments and auto-import, with mandatory security hardening in dashboardGuard.js.

commits.author: Sofia
commits.subject: fix(opencode-go): use current inference endpoint
commits.behavior: Updates OpenCode Go from retired /zen/go/v1 (which answers 403) to current https://opencode.ai/inference/go/* endpoints.
commits.rationale: Essential endpoint migration for OpenCode Go provider.

commits.author: yohansyahck
commits.subject: fix(cli-tools): include no-auth, alias and custom models in Add All Active Models
commits.behavior: Expands Add All Active Models helper to include free no-auth providers (OpenCode Free), user aliases, and custom models while excluding disabled models.
commits.rationale: Clean dashboard usability enhancement.

commits.author: mj10612
commits.subject: fix(runtime): keep runtime installs local during global npm hooks
commits.behavior: Passes --global=false to runNpmInstall helper in cli/hooks/sqliteRuntime.js.
commits.rationale: KhatamRouter deleted cli/hooks/sqliteRuntime.js and uses bun:sqlite natively without Node/npm installation hooks.

commits.author: decolua
commits.subject: fix(dedupe): drop tool_reference blocks naming stripped tools
commits.behavior: Drops dangling tool_reference blocks when tools are stripped by MCP dedupe, avoiding 400 Bad Request on strict upstreams (z.ai code 1210).
commits.rationale: Clean fix for MCP tool deduplication.
